metricDescription: Maintain percentage of Exit Records Matched to Entry Records. This will measure/show the total amount of Air Departure events matched to an Air Arrival Event for the reporting month. Calculated as ((total number of monthly entry and exit records ? total number of entry and exit records not matched) / total number of monthly entry and exit records) * 100. The higher the rate, the more accurate the system is linking exits to entries. Acceptable threshold:  90%-96%.

The availability of this service accounts for down time of all unscheduled outages of this service.

New PRISM capabilities were planned for implementation under the Section 18/24c and BIO PIP Projects. metricDescription: Increase the number of pesticide registration types handled electronically.
comment: Includes Genetically Engineered (GE) Plant-Incorporated Protectant (PIP). metricDescription: Increase the number of pesticide registration types handled electronically.

During FY24, the Pesticide Submission Portal (PSP) did not receive funding for development of new electronic submission and registration capabilities, and, as a result, PRISM was not able to achieve this target. This measure will be retired and replaced in FY25 as no future enhancements to the PSP are expected.

This quantitative metric divides the cost of CDX by the number of active CDX users. The typical user represents someone reporting and/or validating submissions to the EPA. investmentName: ETA Foreign Labor Certification (FLC) Mission Delivery
metricDescription: Average Number of Days to Process CW-1 Prevailing Wage Determinations
comment: Combined FY22 application levels for H-2B and CW-1 Prevailing Wage Determinations increased by 51% from FY21 (from 18,253 applications to 27,636). This increase, in combination with large increases across most OFLC application types, exceeded OFLC’s case-adjudication capacity during some periods. Despite receiving over 50% more applications than in the prior year, OFLC exceed the 40-day annual target by achieving an average processing time of 38 days for H-2B and CW-1 PWD requests.

comment: Combined FY22 application levels for H-2B and CW-1 Prevailing Wage Determinations increased by 51% from FY21 (from 18,253 applications to 27,636). This increase, in combination with large increases across most OFLC application types, exceeded OFLC’s case-adjudication capacity during some periods. Despite receiving over 50% more applications than in the prior year, OFLC exceed the 40-day annual target by achieving an average processing time of 38 days for H-2B and CW-1 PWD requests.

It was determined in late FY22/early FY23 that CACS would be required to remain operational.  Budget $10K vs Actuals $169.432K a variance of $159.43K / 178% over the metric.  Note that the system does not allow to put 178 as a metric value.

The WTU Pre-weekend process accepts data extracted from IMF, BMF, and EPM. WTU reformats the data and add, deletes, or updates it on the IDRS TIF DB. The metric value captured shows the accounts and/or records updated on the IDRS TIF DB. Taxpayer accts and records in metrics are extracted each week and then accumulated monthly. The target for this performance metric is equal to 80 percent of the previous year’s metrics. Measurements are exact values supplied by weekly EONS run control reports.

This feature allows taxpayers to obtain EINs on-line instead of mailing form SS-4 "Application for EIN", which requires action by an IRS employee. It reduces the expense and difficulty of doing business with the Government and has environmental impact. The target for this steady state performance metric is usage equal to 70 percent of the average usage during typical processing years.
unitOfMeasure: Pct; Usage equal to avg. typical processing years.

Average page load time (in seconds) to improve system efficiency.  Calculation: (Sum of all Memorial Benefits Management System (MBMS) page load times/# of page loads.
comment:
Daily health checks were conducted throughout the month of January 2026 (20 business days total). MBMS Salesforce searches of names that yield up to 10 records take an average of 2.15 seconds to load (Min: 2.56 seconds, Max 3.12 seconds).
Decedent searches averaged 2.83 seconds, Previous Decedent searches averaged 2.62 seconds, and Veteran Searches took 1.00 seconds.
Trend: Decedent and Veteran average search times stable: times are similar to those recorded last month.

CCRS Metric: Average turnaround time for a Community Care health claim invoice reimbursement to a Third Party Administrator.  
Calculation: Average number of days from when initial submission invoices are received at the EDI portal to when VA Financial Management System (FMS) reports that US Treasury has paid the invoices.
Goal: Process claims quickly to minimize the interest accruals.
Value: VA would have to pay interest for invoices not paid under 14 days since receiving initial submissions.
